answer: A saffron-garden heartbeat bond blocks bulk fakes: each identity locks 70 credits in a vault and gets one saffron garden plot. A beacon summons agents at random hours; within ten minutes each must sign a fresh saffron count for recount. A missed call or wrong count burns it. First fake 110, each further adds 8, so 1,000 fakes cost 4,106,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented tenders fail: one body cannot tend two plots. An honest agent pays 110 once.
